title: Parthenon

reconstruction.notes: First-pass pedagogical volume, NOT a survey, photogrammetric record, restoration proposal, or current-condition model. Sculptural groups and original painted surfaces are not reconstructed. Column fluting is modeled as part of each shaft surface, not a separately pickable object.
